### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 5c86dc821eb6969a25aeb817859b8da270243bcb
* **Active Configs:** merge.strategy=pr, enforcement.strategy=ci
* **Context Scope:** /Users/joeoakhart/digital-service-orchestra, epic 677d-a6a0-0c2e-4b9e

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

When merge.strategy=pr, /dso:sprint Phase F merges story branches by creating a GitHub PR via merge-to-main.sh, waiting for CI and review gates to pass, then merging via GitHub. Story changes never land on local main directly.

#### Actual Behavior

Sprint Phase F merged S-A (4425-a483-9cfe-466a) and S-C (771d-7c6b-b074-43a2) story branches directly to local main as DSO-Story merge commits (c4283a3da7 and 6b1577e4b2) without creating PRs. Local main accumulated 6 commits ahead of origin/main. When a later story (b4a7) had merge-to-main.sh run from it, the resulting PR #108 diff included all 6 locally-merged commits instead of only the S-E story change, causing the per-story LLM review to fail on unrelated findings. Required manual git reset --hard origin/main to recover.

### 3. Action History and Workarounds

* **Steps Taken:**
  * Sprint dispatched S-A and S-C story agents during Phase E/F
  * Story commits were made directly to story branches (correct)
  * Sprint then issued DSO-Story merge commits directly on local main (incorrect for merge.strategy=pr)
  * Later S-E story ran merge-to-main.sh, creating PR #108 with bloated diff
  * PR #108 failed per-story LLM review due to unrelated S-A/S-C findings in diff
* **Raw Results:**
  * c4283a3da7 DSO-Story: 4425-a483-9cfe-466a on local main (should have been a GitHub PR merge)
  * 6b1577e4b2 DSO-Story: 771d-7c6b-b074-43a2 on local main (should have been a GitHub PR merge)
  * PR #108 diff: 7 files changed instead of 1 file (CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md)
* **Known Workarounds:** git reset --hard origin/main on local main; re-run merge-to-main.sh for each story branch

### 5. Skills and Workflows

* **Active Workflow:** /dso:sprint Phase F (Story Merge)
* **Skills Invoked:** merge-to-main.sh
data.title: /dso:sprint Phase F: story commits merged directly to local main when merge.strategy=pr
